notes:
Account background: Auric Augmentors builds an agent-augment platform used by ~120 enterprise customers (CCaaS integrations). They sell a workflow layer that plugs into Zendesk and Freshdesk; primary customers are e‑commerce and fintech CX teams. Interested in replacing brittle rule-based summarizers + heuristics with an LLM-powered summarization + auto-tagging flow.

Recent timeline / activity (bullets):
- 2024-11-05: Intro call (Maya + Diego) — product fit looks strong; they emphasized latency sensitivity for live agent assist.
- 2024-12-12: Technical deep-dive with engineering (Diego, Auric infra team) — shared sandbox logs, token distribution, typical convo length ~250 tokens.
- 2025-01-14: Security kickoff (Riley + Redwood security) — requested SOC2 evidence and KMS integration options.
- 2025-01-28: Demo (Fireflies ff_2025-01-28_auric-demo) — showed end-to-end ticket summarization + macro trigger prototype.
- 2025-02-07: Security follow-up (ff_2025-02-07_security-call) — Auric wants customer-managed keys (HSM/KMS) and audit log retention 7 years.
- 2025-02-10: POC scope agreed: 2 weeks dedicated capacity POC with 24/7 load spikes simulation; integration with Zendesk app + SSO test.

Use-case & technical requirements (short):
- Primary: Ticket/email summarization (concise TL;DR + suggested macros). Secondary: auto-tagging for routing and SLA prioritization.
- Workflow: Zendesk/Freshdesk app, suggested macros (one-click apply), webhook to their routing engine.
- Latency: P50 target < 250ms for agent-assist calls; P95 < 1s acceptable. For batched async summarization (overnight digest) throughput must handle 3k–5k reqs/min during campaign peaks.
- Availability: 99.9% SLA desired for agent-facing endpoints.
- Model preferences: preference for open quantized models (lower cost) for bulk tagging; higher-quality LLM (larger variant) for real-time agent assist. Auto-fallback to cheaper variant acceptable under cost constraints.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-high; expects Redwood Optimize recommendations to reduce per-token cost ~20–40% vs current baseline.

Integrations & security notes: 
- Zendesk app: needs packaging for Zendesk Marketplace (app manifest + OAuth flow).
- SSO: SAML + SCIM for provisioning; test account ready.
- Data residency: US/EU separation for some customers (need regional routing).
- KMS: customer-managed keys required for Dedicated/private.
- Audit: full request/response audit logging for compliance audits.

POC acceptance criteria (agreed):
- End-to-end summarization accuracy > 85% (based on Auric eval rubric) on 5 sample datasets.
- Agent-assist latency P50 < 250ms during normal load; degrade gracefully with explained fallback during spikes.
- Auto-tagging precision > 80% for top-5 tags on test set.
- Successful SSO and KMS integration in sandbox.

Quotes / call snippets (raw):
- "Can't have agents waiting more than a second — even half a second matters during peak chat loads." — Head of CX, T. Morgan.
- "We need clear fallback rules: if the big model is saturated, fall back to cached summary or smaller model and annotate that it was degraded." — Eng lead, S. Patel.

Open action items / next steps:
- Redwood: Share dedicated POC config + cost estimate for 2-week run (Diego).
- Auric: Provide sample Zendesk tenant with anonymized tickets and tag taxonomy (Due 2025-02-18).
- Security: Finalize KMS key policy and perform test rotation (Riley + Auric security).
- Product: Roadmap note to add one-click macro suggestions to console (feature request).

Blockers (short): security KMS policy, pricing for sustained spike capacity, Zendesk app packaging timeline.

Misc: Linked drive deck contains sample tag taxonomy and scoring rubric; Jira RDW-4351 opened for POC infra requests.

Tone & style: Notes are truncated agent-style; follow-ups logged in gmail threads.
